summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Srivani Book Stall (Next.js 15). PUBLIC read-only surface is EXCELLENT: homepage, search, catalogue with filters/sort/price/pagination, SEO collection pages, product pages (with JSON-LD, related & you-may-also-need rows), WhatsApp links, sitemap/robots/manifest, 404s, mobile 390px layout (no horizontal overflow), and admin auth gating (cookie-based) all PASS. However, ALL server-action POSTs (form submissions) are being rejected by Next.js with `Invalid Server Actions request` because the reverse proxy sets Origin=discover-srivani.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud while x-forwarded-host=discover-srivani.preview.emergentagent.com. This is a single-line config fix but blocks every write operation in the app: enquiry submissions (ask-srivani, school-list, bulk-enquiry), admin product create/edit/delete, admin settings save, admin offers save, admin banner save, admin CSV import, admin enquiry status changes, and admin flag toggles. Verified via Mongo: after all attempted form submissions, enquiries=0, settings=0, no new QA product persisted.

critical.issue: Aborted with 'Invalid Server Actions request. x-forwarded-host (discover-srivani.preview.emergentagent.com) does not match origin (discover-srivani.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud)'. Root cause: /app/frontend/next.config.mjs is missing experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins (or allowedForwardedHosts) for the cluster hostname. Every form POST returns 500 and no data is written to Mongo.

minor.issue: Recurring dev-server warnings: ENOENT prerender-manifest.json, 'Cannot find module ./611.js', segment-explorer-node.js not found in React Client Manifest, __webpack_modules__[moduleId] is not a function, HMR websocket 502. Does not break public pages but indicates a stale/broken .next cache.

ui_bugs.issue: Form appears to submit as a GET (settings-* names are appended to URL as query string ?whatsapp=...&bannerTitle=...). This is the fallback when the server action fails, and it leaks all settings into the URL bar. Verified in server log: 'GET /admin/settings?bannerActive=true&bannerTitle=...&whatsapp=919999999999...' Users think it saved, but nothing is written. Ensure the form has explicit action=serverAction OR provide a name-less handler.

integration_issues.flow: Enquiry submission (Ask Srivani / School List / Bulk Enquiry)
integration_issues.issue: POST returns 500 (Invalid Server Actions request). enquiry-success never renders. Mongo `enquiries` collection remains empty. Blocks the entire lead-generation surface of the app.
pf-submit POST rejected. Redirect to /admin/products happens but product is NOT created in Mongo. /product/qa-test-product returns 404. Same root cause (Server Actions origin mismatch).
settings-save does not persist. Public WhatsApp link on product page still uses 919849212345 after saving 919999999999. Mongo `settings` collection has 0 documents.
Cannot verify status persistence because no enquiries exist (enquiry POSTs all failed). Once server actions are fixed, retest is needed.

action_items: CRITICAL FIX: In /app/frontend/next.config.mjs add experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins (and/or allowedForwardedHosts) to trust the Kubernetes cluster hostname. Example: experimental: { serverActions: { bodySizeLimit: '15mb', allowedOrigins: ['discover-srivani.preview.emergentagent.com', 'discover-srivani.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud', '*.preview.emergentagent.com', '*.preview.emergentcf.cloud'], allowedForwardedHosts: ['discover-srivani.preview.emergentagent.com', 'discover-srivani.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud'] } }. Then restart frontend supervisor.

After the fix, retest all form flows: ask-srivani, school-list (with and without file), bulk-enquiry, admin product create/edit/delete, admin settings save+restore, admin offers create, admin banner edit, admin CSV import (preview + apply + re-apply), admin flag toggles, admin enquiry status change, and admin logout.

Investigate AdminSettingsForm: ensure the form uses the server action rather than falling back to native GET; consider adding method='post' and dropping input name attributes that would otherwise become URL params on fallback.
Clear stale .next cache once (rm -rf /app/frontend/.next && supervisorctl restart frontend) to eliminate the recurring 'Cannot find module ./611.js' errors.
critical_code_review_comments: next.config.mjs: Under a reverse proxy, Server Actions must have both allowedOrigins and allowedForwardedHosts configured, otherwise every write action is 500'd.

Controls.jsx (AdminSettingsForm): the form's server-action fallback dumps every setting into the URL as query params on failure — this is a confusing UX and also leaks internal field structure; server action failures should surface an error toast, not navigate.

seed.js / lib/products.js: seeded data is loaded server-side lazily; ensure invalidate/revalidate happens after product create in saveProductAction (revalidatePath('/catalogue'), etc.) — cannot fully verify until server actions work.

success_rate.frontend: Public read-only ~100% (46/46 assertions PASS); write/admin flows ~15% (only cookie-gated navigation works; every server-action POST fails)

test_credentials: Admin cookie session_token=test_session_admin_srivani works — /admin renders dashboard with emergentttt.2@gmail.com. No changes made to sessions/users.
seed_data_creation: No test data persisted because server actions failed. Mongo state at end of run: products=100 (unchanged seed), enquiries=0, settings=0, users=1, sessions=1 (admin test session preserved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public surface is fully verified: homepage/testids, search (class 10 maths=9, navneet=6, ssc=4, a4 notebook=1, telugu novel=3, nonsense=empty), catalogue filters+pagination+sort+price, SEO pages (/books=74, /stationery=18, /books/class-10=8, /books/ssc=3, /books/school=39, /books/competitive-exams=14), product page (mathematics-class-10) with JSON-LD Book/Product, WhatsApp href starts with wa.me/919849212345, mobile 390 scrollWidth=390 (no overflow), /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt, /manifest.webmanifest, 404s for /randomsection and /product/does-not-exist. After main agent fixes next.config.mjs allowedOrigins, focus retest on: enquiry submissions, admin CRUD, CSV import, offers/banner save, settings persistence, and logout (do logout LAST and recreate session with the mongosh command in /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
rca of the issue: Next.js 15 Server Actions include an anti-CSRF check that requires the Origin header to match either the request Host or an entry in experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins, and forwarded hosts must match allowedForwardedHosts. In this Kubernetes preview, the ingress forwards requests with Origin=discover-srivani.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud but sets X-Forwarded-Host=discover-srivani.preview.emergentagent.com. The current next.config.mjs only sets allowedDevOrigins (which is a different, dev-only option) and experimental.serverActions only has bodySizeLimit. Consequently, Next.js aborts every server action with 'Invalid Server Actions request' (visible in /var/log/supervisor/frontend.*.log). Reproduction: navigate to /ask-srivani, fill the form, click Submit — network tab shows POST to same URL returning 500 with error digest, and no [data-testid=enquiry-success] appears. Mitigation: add allowedOrigins and allowedForwardedHosts to experimental.serverActions in next.config.mjs covering both hostnames (or use wildcard patterns supported by your Next version), then restart the frontend.
